title: Job completion
description: What a performer posts to complete a job, with the current lease token in the request. A verify job is completed with its verification report and the manifest of the outputs it uploaded; a document job with the write-up and no manifest. A second completion of the same job is idempotent.

document.description: Markdown with YAML front matter: the verification report of a verify job (`verification.schema.json`, optional body), or the write-up of a document job (`writeup.schema.json`, non-empty body).
